description: Defines the HttpStreamFactory class and related nested classes, enums, and methods for managing HTTP stream requests, including WebSocket and bidirectional streams, within the Chromium networking code.

classes.name: HttpStreamFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating and managing HTTP streams, including WebSocket and bidirectional streams, with support for alternative services and preconnections.

classes.name: HttpStreamFactory::Job
classes.description: Represents a network job for establishing an HTTP stream.

classes.name: HttpStreamFactory::JobController
classes.description: Manages a set of jobs related to a single request or preconnect.

classes.name: HttpStreamFactory::JobFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating Job instances.

methods.name: RequestStream
methods.description: Initiates a request for an HTTP stream.

methods.name: RequestWebSocketHandshakeStream
methods.description: Initiates a WebSocket handshake stream request.

methods.name: PreconnectStreams
methods.description: Preconnects a specified number of streams for a given request.

methods.name: GetHostMappingRules
methods.description: Returns host mapping rules used for rewriting hostnames.

methods.name: RewriteHost
methods.description: Rewrites the host of a given URL scheme and host/port.

methods.name: OnJobControllerComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of a JobController, cleaning up resources.
